no test covers how the dashboard loads `loadContextDocs` or passes the result to `ContextPanel`; Grep finds no `getDocsTree` or `data-context-card` in src/views/__tests__/DashboardView.spec.ts. Only the component is tested, with fixed props.

Acceptance bullet 2 is not met. The issue says "list the missing fields in the PR body under 'Needs API'" and requires the body to list "every field that fell back to `—` and which endpoint would need to supply it". The PR body has no "Needs API" section. It only has Summary, Changes (a copy of the issue) and Evidence. The fallback fields (Docs Created/Read this week, the Memory header and all three Memory rows, Graph Nodes/Edges/Last updated/health) are listed only in the `src/design-system/components/ContextPanel.vue:11-15` docblock, and no endpoint is named for any of them.

The Docs header value and "Updated this week" (`ContextPanel.vue:33`) are counted from `docs.entries` on the client, which the documented contract says is capped. `src/lib/api/types.ts:644-645` says "never client-recount `entries`, the tree response may cap/paginate individual entries independently of these totals". The mock also slices entries when `limit` is set (`mockAdapter.ts:1724`). If the server caps the tree, both numbers come out too low and look authoritative.

The Memory header is hardcoded to `—` even though the same tree response has server-authoritative knowledge counts: `counts: DocsCounts` with `patterns`, `pitfalls`, `learnings`, `decisions` (`types.ts:646-657`), and `type === 'knowledge'` entries that carry `modifiedAt` (`types.ts:634`). The docblock says "There is no memory or graph endpoint" and never explains why the knowledge counts don't count as memories.

Nothing tests the DashboardView wiring. A grep of the spec for `getDocsTree|Context|loadInstances` finds nothing. The new `loadContextDocs` path (`DashboardView.vue:248-256`) and the third grid column are untested. `ContextPanel.spec.ts` mounts the component alone with hand-built props.

The component uses no `<script setup>` design citation. It is marked "no mock — vocabulary extension", but the issue refers to a "2026-10 design" with three panel cards. The docblock doesn't say which frame or node it follows. Compare DashboardView's citation of Figma node `13-994`.
